ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description: Flat error body (OD-15, D-9): the same shape main.py emits for INTERNAL.

MoveConfirm.title: MoveConfirm
MoveConfirm.description: 200 with ok=false: the move needs a planner's confirm. The client reads `ok`, never the status.

MovePreview.title: MovePreview
MovePreview.description:
GET /preview, and a CONFIRM's preview: movePreview (923-937) when the rules pass. `confirm` is the
service's decision (OD-116), not moveRules'.

toIso.title: Toiso
toIso.description: yyyy-MM-dd - the day the WO should start on

expectStartIso.title: Expectstartiso
expectStartIso.description: the start the client saw; STALE if it moved

MoveRequest.title: MoveRequest
MoveRequest.description:
POST /api/v1/planner/move. dryRun defaults to false - the UI's real move; the smoke sends true
first (OD-111).

MoveResult.title: MoveResult
MoveResult.description: 200 ok from /move and /undo: moveWO's plan dict, plus the actor who moved it.

RangeData.title: RangeData
RangeData.description: GET /api/v1/planner/range - the Ignition rangeData dict plus the OD-14 envelope. No `gate`.

UndoRequest.title: UndoRequest
UndoRequest.description: POST /api/v1/planner/undo - the `undo` dict a move returned. Confirm is implied.

WriteError.title: WriteError
WriteError.description:
404 / 409 / 422 / 500 from the move routes: OD-15's flat body plus the oracle's sid, and the start
the WO has now on STALE.
